# Pertemuan 2
```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
data(iris)
head(iris)
```

```{r}
iris_long <- iris %>%
  gather(key = "Measurement", value = "Value", -Species)

head(iris_long)
```

```{r}
iris_separated <- iris_long %>%
  separate(Measurement, into = c("Part", "Dimension"), sep = "\\.")

head(iris_separated)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
data(PlantGrowth)
df = PlantGrowth
glimpse(df)
pull(df, weight)
slice_max(df, weight, n = 5)
```

```{r}
library(tidyr)
crossing(df)
```
